status: WT lane 2026-11-24, registered before any tour frame was rendered; overrides knowledge/flythrough/villa-policy.json
turn_rate_basis: ASSUMED policy, inside the client-requested 30-45 deg/s comfortable band for an on-screen pan; a full 360 takes 9 s. No published standard claimed.
turn_accel_basis: ASSUMED: yaw rate ramps 0 to 40 deg/s in 0.44 s so no turn starts or stops with a snap
best_view_hold_basis: ASSUMED short pause on the room's best view (the same subject as its still view in knowledge/render-set/views.json)
walk_yaw_rate_basis: ASSUMED: walking speed drops wherever the heading would turn faster than this
lookahead_basis: ASSUMED: the camera heading is the direction of the route 1.5 m ahead, so it always looks where it is going
point_wall_clearance_basis: production forward-wall screen (camera_wall_sightline_clearance, 1.0 m); the 360 point keeps every direction clear, so no frame of the turn faces a wall within 1 m
pitch_basis: ASSUMED: the camera looks up the flight while climbing and down the void from the top landing; vertical lens shift is used, as for every still
